problems: The wall boards are 0.15 tall on a 0.16 pitch with nothing behind them, so the sky shows through as blue slits on the left wall. Above the header, dark vertical seams show where the short centre boards meet the side boards. The wall reads as loose slats, not a solid saloon front. Fix: put a solid backing behind the boards around the doorway, and run the boards above the header the full width in one piece.

The barrel hinges are almost invisible and sit at y=-0.005, centred on the hinge line inside the post face. Their leaves float in front of the post (y=-0.03), not against its inner face. Fix: move each hinge barrel to the door's hinge edge and set its leaf against the post's inner face so the door visibly hangs from the post.
